meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research for design direction. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建、优化和美化前端界面与交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发或改进网页的用户界面和体验
copy.tagline_en: Build, optimize, and polish frontend UI and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop or improve web user interfaces and experiences

howto.what: Claude会按照高级设计师的标准，为你构建或改进网页界面。它会先分析你的需求，加载专业的设计和性能规则，然后生成一个设计文档（DESIGN.md）作为合同，再实现组件，最后自动进行视觉比较和性能审计（Lighthouse 100分），确保可用性和可访问性。
howto.when: 当你说出“设计”、“前端”、“重新设计”等关键词，或要求参考某个品牌（如Stripe、Linear）时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个类似Stripe的落地页。
say.note: Claude会加载Stripe的设计系统并生成高质量页面。

say.text: 优化这个React组件的性能，达到Lighthouse 100。
say.note: Claude会进行Playwright审计并优化代码架构。

say.text: 把这个页面重新设计成极简风格，并生成DESIGN.md。
say.note: Claude会加载极简设计规则并创建设计文档。

howto.what_en: Claude builds or improves web UI following a senior designer's standard. It analyzes requests, loads design and performance rules, creates a DESIGN.md contract, implements components, then runs visual QA and Lighthouse 100 audits for accessibility and usability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like design, frontend, redesign, or reference a brand (e.g., Stripe, Linear).

say_en.text: Design a landing page like Stripe's.
say_en.note: Claude loads Stripe's design system and generates a high-quality page.

say_en.text: Optimize this React component for Lighthouse 100.
say_en.note: Claude runs Playwright audit and refactors architecture.

say_en.text: Redesign this page in minimal style and create DESIGN.md.
say_en.note: Claude loads minimal taste rules and produces design document.
